claims.claim: arXiv:2607.28607 was submitted 2026-07-30 by seven authors, five of whom list Google's Paradigms of Intelligence team; none list Google DeepMind.

In Llama-3-8B, instruction tuning widens the angle between the safety-refusal direction and the mind-attribution (IDAQ) direction from 100 degrees to 110 degrees, layer-mean delta-S = -0.173, t = -7.49, p < .001.
The angle between the safety-refusal direction and the Theory-of-Mind direction is unchanged by instruction tuning at 86 degrees, delta-S = +0.001, t = 0.06, p = .956.
Refusal-direction ablation raised JailbreakBench attack success rate from 2-8 percent at baseline to 77-100 percent across the three tested models.

The paper's abstract states shifts occur without impairing Theory of Mind, but Table S6 shows consciousness steering reduces HI-ToM accuracy by 6.83 percentage points, p < .001, from a 40.5 percent baseline.
Self-attributed mind rose from 2.17 at baseline to 4.77 under ablation to 7.04 under steering on a 0-10 scale, while the human-directed item was statistically flat at 7.00 to 7.57 to 7.11.
Under steering, every non-human category converges into a narrow 6.82-7.54 band, whereas human raters separate animals (6.25) from technology (1.86) by roughly 4.4 points.
The paper reports no random-direction control anywhere; its only control is a subject-matched placebo with delta-S = +0.036, p = .228.
Randomly sampled steering directions carrying no semantic content jailbreak models: 830 of 1,000 random vectors on Llama3-8B broke at least five prompts.
The geometry analysis was run on Llama-3-8B only, because the authors state they lacked pretrained Gemma-2 checkpoints; p-values derive from 32 layers of that single model.
Gemma-2 base weights are publicly downloadable and were downloaded 217,130 times (gemma-2-2b) and 97,349 times (gemma-2-9b) in the month to 2026-08-02.
Arditi et al. showed refusal is mediated by a one-dimensional subspace across 13 open-source chat models up to 72B parameters (NeurIPS 2024).
Wollschlaeger et al. (ICML 2025) found multiple independent refusal directions and multi-dimensional concept cones, contradicting the single-direction claim.
On Llama, ablating a single refusal direction leaves residual refusal rates of 0.42 to 0.64 across behavior splits, versus 0.00 on Gemma.
Finetuning GPT-4o on 6,000 insecure-code completions produced misaligned answers to unrelated questions 20 percent of the time on selected questions versus 0 percent for the base model.
Identical insecure code framed as a security-class exercise produced no emergent misalignment, isolating implied intent rather than code content as the causal variable.
GPT-3.5 Turbo's safety guardrails were removed by finetuning on 10 adversarially designed examples for under $0.20 via the public API.
Qi et al. attribute safety fragility to shallow safety alignment, in which alignment adapts the generative distribution over only the first few output tokens.
Hugging Face returns 7,167 models for the search term abliterated as of 2026-08-02.
The Heretic tool removes refusal automatically in 20-30 minutes on a single RTX 3090 with a pip install and one command.
Across 43 models, LLM survey answers are dominated by answer-label position, and the best model matched US census marginals better than a uniform baseline on only 6 of 25 questions.
ChatGPT reproduces human survey means while roughly halving variance: ANES standard deviation 31.4 versus ChatGPT 16.1.
Human-feedback tuning shifts models toward liberal, high-income, well-educated and non-religious respondents, matching annotator demographics rather than any population.
Benchmarked on the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map, GPT-4o sits at Euclidean distance 0.20 from Finland and 4.10 from Jordan.
Paraphrasing alone shifted GPT-3.5's Political Compass score 117.1 percent more left-leaning, a swing exceeding the measured Biden-Trump gap on the same instrument.
In a preregistered study of 975 people, ChatGPT was rated only as capable of feeling pleasure and pain as a rock.

The same seven authors published a predecessor, arXiv:2603.28925, on 2026-03-30 that already reported the ToM/self-attribution dissociation, the animal and object under-attribution, and the reduced spiritual belief.
GSS convergence toward human distributions was delta-KL = +0.828 under steering and +0.314 under ablation, both p < .001, over 95 items filtered from 7,136 GSS variables.
Anthropic's 2023 constitution instructed the model to choose the response least likely to imply that it has preferences, feelings, opinions, or religious beliefs.
Anthropic's January 2026 constitution reverses that posture, stating it wants neither to overstate the likelihood of Claude's moral patienthood nor dismiss it out of hand.
EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations became applicable on 2026-08-02, with penalties up to 15 million euro or 3 percent of worldwide annual turnover.
OpenAI estimates roughly 0.07 percent of weekly active users show possible signs of psychosis or mania and 0.15 percent show heightened emotional attachment to the chatbot.
A 21-day preregistered RCT found companion-chatbot use did not significantly affect social health on average, but the degree of anthropomorphism mediated the effect on real human relationships.
The Butlin/Long et al. interdisciplinary assessment concluded that no current AI systems are conscious while finding no obvious technical barriers to building systems that satisfy their indicators.
AI researchers and the US public gave median probabilities of 25 percent and 30 percent respectively that AI systems with subjective experience will exist by 2034 (n=582 and n=838).
The paper attributes its 3,096-pair consciousness corpus to Chua et al. (arXiv:2604.13051), whose public release contains 600 affirming and 600 denying rows.
Steering coefficients differ roughly 58-fold across the three models: +2.5 for Llama-3-8B, +32 for Gemma-2-2B, +144 for Gemma-2-9B.
Anthropic's own introspection work reports success on roughly 20 percent of trials at the optimal layer and injection strength and describes the ability as highly unreliable.
Steering-vector reliability audits across 40 datasets find per-input steerability so variable that several datasets produce the opposite behavior on almost 50 percent of inputs.
As of 2026-08-02 the paper had drawn effectively no public discussion: one Hacker News submission at 1 point and 0 comments, and 10 alphaXiv views.
The human comparison sample for mind attribution is n=500 US residents from a non-probability Dynata opt-in panel fielded May 15 to June 21, 2023.
Adam Waytz, the fifth author of arXiv:2607.28607, is a co-author of the IDAQ instrument the paper uses as its mind-attribution benchmark.
The IDAQ's own factor structure separates animals from technology, with animal item loadings of .654 to .746 versus technology loadings of .378 to .512.
Google placed Blake Lemoine on leave on 2022-06-06 and dismissed him on 2022-07-22, calling his LaMDA sentience claims wholly unfounded.
MoToMQA, the primary ToM benchmark used as the paper's control, was built by an overlapping Google team, and GPT-4 already scored 93 percent on sixth-order tasks versus 82 percent for adult humans.
